examples.arabic: بعدين قعدوا يتكلموا ويشربوا عصير ويستنوا باقي الأصحاب
examples.english: Then they sat talking, drinking juice, and waiting for the rest of the friends.
examples.transliteration: Ba'deen qa'adu yetkallemu we yeshrabu 'aseer we yestannu ba'i el-aṣḥab.

examples.arabic: بصيت على المنيو ولقيت عصير فاكهة
examples.english: I looked at the menu and found fruit juice.
examples.transliteration: Basseet 'ala el menu we la'eet 'aseer fakha.
examples.storyTitle: Waiting for My Friend at the Café

examples.arabic: الكل بياكل كتير وبيشرب عصير وميّة باردة
examples.english: Everyone eats a lot and drinks juice and cold water.
examples.transliteration: El-kol beyakel keteer we beyeshrab `aseer we mayya barda.

examples.english: We ate delicious cake and drank juice
examples.transliteration: Akalna torta ladheetha w sheribna aseer

examples.english: They all eat cake and drink juice.
examples.transliteration: Kolhom biyaklo torta we biyeshrabo aseer

examples.arabic: احنا بنحب نقعد هنا ونشرب عصير فاكهة
examples.english: We love to sit here and drink fruit juice.
examples.transliteration: Ehna benhebb no'od hena we neshrab 'aseer fakha.
